intro: Professionals and everyday users convert miles (mi) to feet (ft) when working across imperial and imperial standards in architectural blueprints, international manufacturing tolerances, athletic track distances, and hardware sizing. One mile (statute) equals 5,280 feet, while 1 foot equals 0.000189 miles. Whether you are verifying length specifications on imported equipment, cross-checking technical datasheets, or scaling practical measurements, this converter applies the exact NIST SP 811 and ISO 80000 reference relationship with instant precision.

faqs.question: How many feet (ft) are in 1 mile (statute) (mi)?
faqs.answer: There are 5,280 feet (ft) in 1 mile (statute) (mi), which rounds to 5,280 ft for everyday calculations. Conversely, 1 foot equals 0.000189 miles.

faqs.question: How do I convert miles to feet (mi to ft)?
faqs.answer: To convert miles to feet, use the formula: ft = mi × 5,280. For example, converting 15 mi gives 79,200 ft.

faqs.question: What is 15 miles in feet?
faqs.answer: 15 miles (mi) equals exactly 79,200 feet (ft) using standard NIST SP 811 and ISO 80000 conversion factors.
